problem:
Title: Characterization of Homeomorphic Topological Spaces/Sufficient Condition

Let $T_1 = \struct{S_1, \tau_1}$ be [[Definition:Topological Space|topological space]].

Let $S_2$ be a [[Definition:Set|set]].

Let $\tau_2$ be a [[Definition:Subset|subset]] of the [[Definition:Powerset|powerset]] $\powerset {S_2}$.

Let $f : S_1 \to S_2$ be a [[Definition:Mapping|mapping]] such that:
:$(1)\quad f$ is a [[Definition:Bijection|bijection]]
:$(2)\quad f^\to \restriction_{\tau_1}$ is a [[Definition:Surjection|surjection]] from $\tau_1$ onto $\tau_2$
where
:$f^\to \restriction_{\tau_1}$ denotes the [[Definition:Restriction of Mapping|restriction]] of $f^\to$ to $\tau_1$
:$f^\to$ denotes the [[Definition:Direct Image Mapping|direct image mapping]] of $f$

Then:
:$\struct{S_2, \tau_2}$ is a [[Definition:Topological Space|topological space]] [[Definition:Homeomorphic Topological Spaces|homeomorphic]] to $T_1$
